meta.title: Voice to Handwriting - Speak it, see it handwritten
meta.description: Speak into the page, watch your words turn into realistic handwriting, and export as PNG or PDF. A free online handwriting generator for cards, letters, journals and social media images.

about.title: About
about.description: Voice to Handwriting is a free web tool that turns speech into handwritten pages: real-time transcription, realistic handwriting rendering, PNG/PDF export. Everything runs locally in your browser.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How Voice to Handwriting handles voice and text data, cookies and third-party advertising.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.description: Terms of use for Voice to Handwriting: license, boundaries and disclaimer.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: Contact Voice to Handwriting: feedback, bug reports and business inquiries.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Handwritten card tutorials, handwriting image tips and inspiration for social media posts.

history.title: History
history.description: Your local handwriting conversions: text and style snapshots, restorable in one click. Stored only in your browser.

home.tagline: Speak a paragraph, get a handwritten page — for cards, letters, journals and social posts
home.footerNote: Speech recognition is provided by your browser (Web Speech API). Desktop Chrome / Edge recommended; your text never leaves your device.
home.adPending: Ad slot · set NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_CLIENT to activate
home.sampleText:
Dear friend,
see these words: I spoke to a web page and they became handwriting. Type, talk, or import audio — then export as an image or PDF. Have a lovely day.

tool.unsupported: This browser doesn't support speech recognition. Chrome / Edge recommended, or just type on the right.
tool.errorDenied: Microphone access denied: click the icon left of the address bar to allow the microphone, then try again
tool.errorNetwork: Recognition service network error, please check your connection and retry
tool.errorStopped: No speech detected for a while, stopped automatically
tool.placeholder: Your speech appears here — you can also paste or type directly
tool.emptyHint: Tap "Tap to speak" below, or type in the editor on the left
tool.statusTranscribe: Transcribing — long files take a while…
tool.errorEmpty: No speech recognized in the audio
tool.errorImport: Transcription failed — try an mp3 / wav / m4a file
tool.modelNote: Fast: ~80MB download; High quality: ~250MB, better Chinese. Model downloads once, audio never leaves your device
